data.title: 阿米娅 · 把下午茶留在桌角
data.description: 阿米娅把已核对的文件放到一旁，双手捧起桌角那杯茶。杯子还温着，她朝你点点头，终于肯让自己停一会儿。
data.promptProse: Amiya sits at her Rhodes Island office desk in a black field coat and blue tunic. The checked documents rest in a tidy stack while she holds a warm teacup in both hands, looking toward the viewer with a relieved smile. Afternoon window light reaches the clear corner of the desk.
data.animaCaption: Both gloved hands cup the teacup above its saucer; the paperwork stays to one side.
data.action: 暂放文件，双手捧起温茶
